decisions: CSharp AsyncContextFields uses the shared ordered prefix: runtime pointers0..Count-1, primary input, result, child handle/context, spill frame, then additional parameters. Input without a value is one byte; child/spill pointer slots exist unconditionally.
SLG currently places result at context0 then primary/additional parameters and conditionally appends spill/child slots. Its result stores and default control result address assume base0.

Use generated shared field positions and one size/alignment scan for native primary/result/child/spill/additional offsets. Register actual result address in task control21 before returning the Task; preserve the distinct IO worker representation and its default result address.

Runtime pointer fields receive their shared physical positions in this prerequisite. Actual runtime-argument transport and reading those five pointer values remain pending and are not claimed by this layout change.
